parts.label: Cab and chest
parts.detail: The red cab rotates upright to form the robot chest; windshield and grille travel with it.

parts.label: Blue windshield
parts.detail: Windshield remains attached to the cab as chest windows.

parts.label: Grille
parts.detail: Front grille travels with the cab and ends near the lower chest.

parts.label: Head
parts.detail: Blue robot head stays above the chest throughout the transformation.

parts.label: Helmet crest
parts.detail: Red crest attached above the head.

parts.label: Hip assembly
parts.detail: Central pelvis linking the torso and legs.

parts.label: Left leg
parts.detail: Rear chassis section becomes the left leg and swings down from the hip.

parts.label: Right leg
parts.detail: Rear chassis section becomes the right leg and swings down from the hip.

parts.label: Left foot
parts.detail: Red foot stays joined to the bottom of the left leg.

parts.label: Right foot
parts.detail: Red foot stays joined to the bottom of the right leg.

parts.label: Left arm
parts.detail: Blue side structure rotates outward from the shoulder; hand follows the arm.

parts.label: Right arm
parts.detail: Blue side structure rotates outward from the shoulder; hand follows the arm.

parts.label: Left hand
parts.detail: Metal hand attached beneath the left arm.

parts.label: Right hand
parts.detail: Metal hand attached beneath the right arm.

parts.label: Left front wheel
parts.detail: Front tire moves with the left arm into a shoulder-side position.

parts.label: Right front wheel
parts.detail: Front tire moves with the right arm into a shoulder-side position.

parts.label: Left rear wheel
parts.detail: Rear tire rides on the outside of the left lower leg.

parts.label: Right rear wheel
parts.detail: Rear tire rides on the outside of the right lower leg.

parts.label: Bumper
parts.detail: Metal bumper remains attached at the cab base and folds with the chest.

parts.label: Left exhaust stack
parts.detail: Exhaust stack stays with the left shoulder structure.

parts.label: Right exhaust stack
parts.detail: Exhaust stack stays with the right shoulder structure.

steps.label: Truck form
steps.caption: Truck silhouette: cab, side wheels, and rear chassis are assembled.

steps.label: Cab lifts
steps.caption: The cab rotates upward while arms and wheels swing outward.

steps.label: Robot form
steps.caption: The cab is the chest; the same chassis parts remain attached as arms and legs.
